picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's leadership of 13 Genesis Mission projects plus involvement in 30 more makes it the single largest node in DOE's national AI-for-science push, signaling where the bulk of federal AI research investment is concentrating.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's role leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others cements a second major hub for the initiative, underscoring how national labs are becoming the backbone of federally funded AI science.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the whole-of-government Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ other federal agencies under an executive order, shows AI-for-science is now formal U.S. policy spanning far beyond DOE.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, is a rare AI materials-discovery startup reaching unicorn-plus scale with direct academic leadership.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents a concrete, large-dollar bet on automating scientific experimentation with AI.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in integrated data infrastructure is a broad, field-wide bet on the data backbone AI-driven science depends on, benefiting researchers well beyond any single institution.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT are deepening a formal AI-and-robotics partnership with reciprocal faculty exchanges, a model of sustained cross-continental academic collaboration rather than a one-off grant.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's release of Apertus 1.5 adds multimodal capability to one of the few fully open large language models trained on European supercomputing infrastructure, a notable counterpoint to closed commercial models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's AGIS program to build self-improving generative foundation models for science marks a significant Japanese national push to compete at the frontier of AI-for-science research.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: The NEURA Gym facility at RWTH Aachen is a large-scale, purpose-built testbed for humanoid and physical AI, reflecting growing industry-academia investment in embodied AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN
